messages:
sam: Heads up — memory surge on runtime-prod-3 around 1976543205, started slicing OOMs for long-sequence requests. Root cause unclear, need quick mitigation playbook. Can someone run profiling snapshot and propose short-term fallbacks?

maya: Saw the alert. profiler shows kernel selector flipping to large-FP ops after token 1024, workspace jumped ~2.5x. KV cache also doing full-prefetch for some tenants.

joel: Confirmed. Stack traces point at kernel 'matmul_v2' chosen for fused-attention; memory spike only when batch > 8 and seq>1024.

li: Immediate actions I suggest:
- enable allocator soft-reserve: `allocator.soft_reserve=0.15`
- force kernel fallback for seq>1024: set `kernel_selector.max_seq=1024`
- reduce continuous batch window: `batching.max_window_ms=20`
- temporarily disable prefetching kv for noisy tenants

maya: Adding circuit-breaker rule draft:
```
circuit_breakers:
  mem_surge:
    metric: gpu_mem_used
    window: 60s
    threshold: 0.85
    action: degrade
    degrade:
      model: rwd-llm-small-quant
      batching: 1
      kv_prefetch: false
```

joel: Also a request-shaping quick policy we can push at the proxy:
- per-request max_tokens=512 for public endpoints
- reject instead of queue when queue_length>30
- if tenant is heavy hitter -> fallback to cached-summary endpoint

infra-bot: snapshot uploaded: s3://redwood-prod/profiler/1976543210/heap_snapshot.pb

sam: Good. For short-term rollout, let's do stepwise:
1) push proxy request-shaping (max_tokens, reject_on_queue)
2) lower allocator.soft_reserve config via staged rollout on runtime-prod-3
3) push kernel_selector.max_seq=1024 as a hotfix
4) enable circuit breaker mem_surge with degrade action to rwd-llm-small-quant

li: I'll take 1+2. joel can handle 3. maya please own CB config and monitoring alerts.

joel: On it. For kernel fallback, we can set `kernel_selector.priority_overrides` for long sequences so it prefers low-memory kernels. snippet:
```
priority_overrides:
  - condition: seq_len > 1024
    prefer: low_memory_kernels
```

maya: Alerts to add:
- paging: when mem_surge enters degrade state -> page #eng-runtime and #incidents
- perf regression buzzer: >20% p95 latency post-degrade

sam: One more note — we should avoid full KV eviction immediately. Instead do staged kv-ttl reduction and selective eviction for tenants with >5% cache churn. That preserves perf for non-noisy tenants.

deploy-bot: deploy started: proxy-config-rollout/1976543284

ops: rolling proxy rule to 30% -> monitor queue_length and error_rate

maya: Early telemetry: queue_length dropped 40%, mem used down 12% after proxy rule. Still seeing memory oscillation on runtime-prod-3, so do step 2 next.

li: Soft-reserve updated on runtime-prod-3 -> now 0.15. Watching.

joel: Kernel override hotfix rolled to canary (2 nodes). If stable for 10m we'll push wider.

sam: Thanks team. After stability, create a condensed playbook entry for postmortem and add exact config snippets to infra repo. For now, if anyone sees p99 OOMs re-alert here.

maya: Will file playbook PR: github.com/redwood/infra/playbooks/mem_surge_fallback.md

li: Observability note — add KV cache hit-rate chart and per-tenant prefetch counters to the mem_surge dashboard.

sam: Great. Closing initial triage. Keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
